question: How many descendants of Jacob and Leah went to Egypt with Jacob?
summary: Genesis 46:9-15a enumerates 32 Leah-descendants by name — Reuben and his four sons, Simeon and his six sons, Levi and his three sons, Judah plus his sons and two grandsons, Issachar and his four sons, Zebulun and his three sons, plus Dinah. That's 32. Genesis 46:15b then totals them at 33.
